scope: Selected source-level boundary families; not an exhaustive static or dynamic call graph

rows.observation: One successful ReadAllBytes return counts the actual returned length; failed calls record unknown progress.
rows.remainingGap: Length metadata before the read is not counted; the API does not expose failed-read prefixes.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Use returned-byte counters diagnostically; keep failures and metadata separate from bytes.

rows.observation: Four result reads in the real owner use decoded-text parse counters and raw returned-byte counters.
rows.remainingGap: Initial request/admission reads execute before the supervisor activates FILE_WORK. They are not included merely because they share the helper.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Begin any future admitting enclosing timer before admission authentication; retain the present diagnostic scope label.

references.anchor: if accounting is not None: accounting.start(

rows.observation: Harness JSON, counted streams, injected content readers, codecs and reconstruction counters cover selected reads/parses.
rows.remainingGap: Open/stat/close calls and all possible transitive library work are not established as an exhaustive application count.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Use the enclosing time/job observation for broad scope; counters diagnose rather than replace that boundary.

rows.observation: Opt-in raw, parse, hash and decoder counters cover the independent auditor and selected compressed payload readers.
rows.remainingGap: Python imports, path checks, stat calls and full runtime activity are not counted as application operations.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Retain raw/decoded/parser units separately and authenticate the actual modules used.

rows.observation: Existing parse counters cover explicit boundaries only.
rows.remainingGap: Native Copy serialize/deserialize round trips and canonical SerializeToElement work bypass those parse counters.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Include this CPU/allocation work in an enclosing duration/memory boundary; do not infer time from counted parses alone.

rows.observation: Directory scans and size samples exist; selected native performance traces count visited entries.
rows.remainingGap: Exists, attributes, link checks, enumeration, path resolution and length queries have no complete attempt/success/failure counter series.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Add a scoped operation boundary only where needed; never relabel visited entries or size samples as bytes transferred or a storage peak.

rows.observation: Two real exclusive DeleteOnClose handles protect registry allocation and study output.
rows.remainingGap: Acquisition/release is not instrumented. Python writer_lease ignores the CloseHandle return value; context exit alone does not prove release succeeded.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Next add checked release and opt-in lifecycle observations. Preserve an original body failure if release also fails; release failure must not become successful closeout.

rows.observation: FileStream owns a sibling DeleteOnClose lease; RequireLeases expects sharing/lock violations as ownership evidence.
rows.remainingGap: Probe rejection is expected success for the ownership check, not automatically a worker failure; lease paths may be outside archive roots.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Classify acquire-held, expected-held probe, release, and failures separately. Preserve native sharing/deletion semantics.

rows.observation: Instrumented pending-file writes/moves/deletes track observed logical lengths and selected transient lifetimes.
rows.remainingGap: Only registered files participate; unknown writes, untracked members and failed length observations prevent whole-process storage claims.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Require a closed set of owned paths and full lifetime accounting before using a logical storage bound.

rows.observation: ManagedStorage tracks exclusive managed-directory lengths; OwnerFileCounters observes copies, logs and lengths.
rows.remainingGap: SampledPeakTrackedFileBytes is a maximum of samples, not a process-wide high-water mark. Failed copies have unknown progress.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Separate exclusive managed storage from sampled external storage and reject unknown members rather than assigning zero.

rows.observation: Enclosing job I/O observes operations but does not enumerate live filesystem storage.
rows.remainingGap: Transient files can grow and disappear between scans. Inherited environment/runtime paths are not an enforced private scratch namespace.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Declare retained, pending, lease, log, scratch and runtime-cache domains; establish confinement or a separate conservative bound. Redirecting TEMP alone is insufficient.

rows.observation: V3 observes publication-observation persistence; supervisor sidecars retain observations through their own stated boundaries.
rows.remainingGap: Each final receipt excludes its own persistence. Job totals overlap application counters and are not additive.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Use the enclosing owner job to observe child tails; preserve self-exclusions and terminal failure semantics.

rows.observation: The owner timer precedes supervisor.start, but file-accounting activation occurs after setup and initial hashes.
rows.remainingGap: validate/start raw reads, hashes and directory creation are not all attributed to owner application counters.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: A complete future outer boundary must include bootstrap work, not merely the four phase receipts.

rows.observation: Owned Windows jobs include native/Python descendants through drain, kernel transfer totals and job memory high water.
rows.remainingGap: Runtime/module loading and library operations lack exhaustive application attribution; monitor memory is sampled at a separate boundary.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Do not add nested job totals, counters or separate lifetime memory peaks as though they were a simultaneous measured peak.

rows.observation: OwnerProcessMonitor observes the child owner through handle cleanup and closed-console hashing.
rows.remainingGap: Its own preparation, later publication/verification, console and exit lie outside that observation; cooperative checks do not hard-bound the monitor.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Define a finite external enforcing boundary or separately bounded/charged monitor work; do not recurse through self-measuring receipts.

rows.observation: Production code refreshes and rechecks required registry history; file/JSON helpers cover some reads.
rows.remainingGap: Future study cost depends on the full pinned history and metadata workload. Current correctness fixtures do not establish that workload bound.
rows.prospectiveTreatment: Include the actual admitted history closure in a future resource declaration; do not rescan or allocate in this inventory task.

prospectiveModel.elapsedBoundary: Before authentication through driver publication, verification, console and exit, with separately bounded outer-monitor work
prospectiveModel.memoryUnit: Explicit process/job commit high-water boundary; monitor separately identified
prospectiveModel.storageUnit: Logical retained plus scratch file bytes over declared complete lifetimes; not allocated disk blocks
prospectiveModel.ioUnit: Kernel job transfer totals; overlapping application bytes, decoded bytes and parser bytes remain separate diagnostics
prospectiveModel.failurePolicy: Unknown observations, failed release, missing membership, process escape or unresolved scratch prevent qualification; missing is never zero
prospectiveModel.cumulativePolicy: Charge all admitted attempts including failed work; never rewrite the first failure or historical totals
prerequisites: Checked lease release and scoped metadata lifecycle observations
Complete owned path/scratch-domain specification and enforcement or defensible external bounds
Finite boundary for outer-monitor work and failure cleanup
Authenticated full owner/native audit/independent audit/publication path under that boundary
Separately justified prospective resource protocol and explicit authorization before measurement
